elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added clause expressly applies “On expiry or termination of this Agreement or an Order Form for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
elements.evidence: Vendor must, at Customer’s request, “provide transition assistance for up to six months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The assistance is expressly provided “at Vendor’s then-current rates.”

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Following the expiry-or-termination trigger, Vendor must “within thirty days, return all Customer Data.”

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause requires return in a “commonly used, machine-readable format,” satisfying a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: After return, Vendor must delete Customer Data from its systems and “certify the deletion to Customer in writing.”

elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added obligations expressly apply on expiry or termination of the Agreement or an Order Form.

elements.element: Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Vendor must provide requested transition assistance for up to six months, which permits and obligates provision for a requested period of at least 90 days.

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Vendor must return all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format within thirty days of the expiry-or-termination trigger.
